notes: English identifies Corthis as a named place: the Fist of Corthis is described as an island, and Gornak and the Butcher are identified by their relation to Corthis. Japanese コーディス/コルシス and Chinese 克塞思/克塞斯 corroborate the place name while showing locale transcription variation. Standardize the Korean place component as 코르티스(Corthis); retain complete source titles and all unrelated wording. The official Korean manual has no direct Corthis entry.
